full_text: Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT A. Francisco Gold Condominium II Bldg, EDSA corner Mapagmahal St., Diliman, Quezon City LEGAL SERVICE OPINION NO. 01 June 2010 FOI LOVELLA CERALVO-SALIBA Bureau of Fire Protection Region IV-A (CALABARZON) Camp Vicente Lim Calamba City Dear FOI Saliba: 72 s. 2010 This pertains to your letter-query requesting our legal opinion on whether the number of years you rendered as a government employee holding a permanent status from your previous employment can be credited to you as to entitle you to a longevity pay of ten percent (10%) of your basic monthly salary for every five (5) years of service as provided for in Republic Act No. 6975. In reply thereto, please be informed that we had already an occasion to answer a similar query in DILG Opinion No. 70 S. 2008. In the said opinion, we opined that not all past services as public official can be tacked in or included in determining the length of service for purposes of availing the longevity pay under Section 71 of RA 6975. The term "allied services" would refer to those services that are attached, connected, similar or alike with the nature of services rendered at the Philippine National Police (PNP), the Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP), and the Bureau of Jail Management and Penology (BJMP). Attached is photocopy of DILG Opinion No. 70 Series of 2008 for your ready perusal. We hope this settles your concern. Very truly yours, By Authority of the Secretary: Y. J US B. Director III Legal: 12/Merle OQUE IV
